newsitem.title: USA: Barrett to divest Uinta Basin properties.
newsitem.headline: Barrett to divest Uinta Basin properties.

text.p: Barrett Resources Corp said on Tuesday that it intends to divest its properties and interests in the Uinta Basin so it can focus on its core areas elsewhere in the Rocky Mountains, the Mid-Continent region and the Gulf of Mexico.
Barrett said in a news release that these proposed divestments were contingent upon receiving an acceptable price.
Barrett also said a decision by the federal Bureau of Land Management will allow it to continue its planned development of the Cave Gulch Field area in Wyoming's Wind River Basin.
Barrett reported second quarter earnings of $0.14 per share, compared with $0.25 for the same period a year ago.
Barrett is an oil and natural gas exploration and production company.
